data.design: Use the existing Misdreavus form: a floating dark head with flowing hair, pink-edged locks and red beads around the neck. The haunted cave adds no costume, skull connection or regional transformation.

moves.description: Level 19. Restrains an affected target from fleeing under ordinary battle rules; it is a battle move, not a cave exit gate.
moves.name: Mean Look

moves.description: Level 23. Available across its cave encounter range and strengthened against a target with a status problem.
moves.name: Hex

description:
A stock Ghost species encountered inside Skull Hollow, absent from the current forest grass table. Its floating head, flowing hair and red neck beads give the encounter a distinct shape from the other cave ghosts. Levitate accompanies disruption through Confuse Ray and Mean Look. Hex is strengthened by a major status condition; confusion alone does not increase its damage.

Its native evolution into Mismagius uses a Dusk Stone. The northern forest and cave update supplies no new evolution item or acquisition quest.
